note: SEED. Combines v2.5 step 20's 'build surface matrix' and 'surface enforceability matrix'. Surfaces and hosting are taken from the AILZ handover document's deployed-resource list so the options are real for this tenant. CAFE M2's three-stage decision tree (tier -> archetype -> build surface) supersedes the selection logic once the CAFE packet arrives.

surfaces.label: Self-hosted Microsoft Agent Framework on Azure Container Apps
surfaces.when_to_use: A deterministic orchestrator must own every transition; per-service workload identity is required; portability matters.
surfaces.hosting: Azure Container Apps environment (workload profile, internal ingress)

conditional_notes.G07: Requires the Presidio PII gateway in the egress path
conditional_notes.G08: Requires content safety on the APIM AI Gateway
conditional_notes.G14: Requires clinical controls configured on the data plane

surfaces.label: Azure AI Foundry hosted agents
surfaces.when_to_use: Rapid assembly where the orchestrator need not be owned and a shared identity is acceptable.
surfaces.hosting: AI Foundry project (deployed as a platform placeholder)
surfaces.rejected_for_this_solution: G04 unavailable - per-service workload identity cannot be enforced. v2.5 selects self-hosted MAF for this reason.

surfaces.label: Copilot Studio + Power Automate + Dataverse
surfaces.when_to_use: Conversational front door with low-code flows where process logic is simple and governance is light.
surfaces.rejected_for_this_solution: Process logic cannot be held in a single transition authority; G07 and G11 unavailable. This was the rejected POC surface.

surfaces.label: Extension point on an incumbent platform that already owns the workflow
surfaces.when_to_use: EVALUATE FIRST. Where an incumbent already owns the workflow graph and the system of record, its extension point must be evaluated on equal terms before any new surface is selected.
surfaces.enforceability: per-incumbent - must be assessed, never assumed
surfaces.note: v2.5 step 20: where an incumbent is rejected, record which obligations it failed.

selection_rules: Evaluate the incumbent platform first; record which obligations it failed if rejected.
A surface that cannot enforce a required obligation natively or conditionally is eliminated.
Where no surface enforces every obligation, return to step 17 and re-examine the facet assignment rather than choosing a different runtime.
Record every conditional obligation as requiring an additional component - those components become cost lines.
